posts.title: Ari can do what you'd sit down at a computer to do
posts.description: Michael Saul on Ari's own computer and real browser: Ari handles files, installs software, books and fills forms online, and asks before it spends money or sends anything.

posts.title: Home Assistant gave Ari a sense of home
posts.description: Michael Saul on wiring Home Assistant, three cameras and a self-hosted NVR into Ari: a dashboard with a live floorplan, and home moments that Ari can act on.

posts.title: Why I built Ari, an AI accountability assistant you text
posts.description: Michael Saul on why Ari exists: reminder apps fail at follow-through, so Ari lives in the chat apps you already answer and keeps you on your goal.
